column1: # Vessel class x variable -> Marginal / Unfavorable limits for Operational Suitability.
# THIS FILE IS THE POLICY. No threshold is ever hardcoded in Python; methods.html
# renders this table verbatim, including the source column, so the published
# methodology cannot drift from the ratings.
# NOTE ON LANGUAGE: what this file drives is CariCOOS "Operational Suitability"
# (Favorable / Marginal / Unfavorable). It is NOT an advisory, warning or watch -
# those are official National Weather Service product names and are used on these
# pages only when quoting NWS verbatim.
# var         canonical variable produced by engine/derive.py
# dir         high = larger is worse (usual); low = smaller is worse (roll_ratio)
# marginal    value at which the class becomes Marginal
# unfavorable value at which the class becomes Unfavorable
# unit        canonical unit the limits are expressed in (SI; the page converts)
# applies_to  comma list of site kinds, or 'route', or '*' for all
# source      the citation, rendered on methods.html. '- VERIFY' = not yet confirmed.
